title: SimGrid: Figure 13 endpoint workloads

paper.title: Lowering entry barriers to developing custom simulators of distributed applications and platforms with SimGrid
paper.locator: Introduction paragraph before Section 2; Section 7, Figures 13-14; reference 66.

source.license: Model files carry SimGrid-team GNU LGPL notices referring to the package. SimGrid package COPYING identifies LGPL-2.1 core, with component notices.

inputs.description: Original generated platform ranges: 1,000 four-core hosts, 100 links, ten-link routes, 100-200 Mflop/s cores, 100-200 MB/s links, 100 Mflop/100 MB workunits. Figure 13 endpoints: 4,000 and 60,000 workunits, seeds zero through nine, both versions.
inputs.access: Synthetic generated inputs; native XML saved for validation cases.

versions.cpu_affinity: one CPU, logical CPU 0, shared host

changes_from_author: Source builds on Ubuntu 24.04 instead of Debian 12 containers.
Only two hardcoded /tmp XML paths moved under run directory; numerical/event logic unchanged.
Exact authors Dockerfile CMake workaround applied for 3.10; configure run from build directory for its old probes.
Optional SMPI/model checking disabled; 3.36 host energy enabled as author driver does.
Dedicated paper Xeon 8380 hardware not matched; intermediate Figure 13 points and Figure 14 core-count sweep not run.

target.observable: Compare original MSG3.10 and S4U3.36 author benchmark makespans and simulator RSS/wall time for paper Figure13 workload, 1000hosts4cores,4000tasks; exploratory diagnostic4hosts40tasks first.
target.reference: Paper introduction explicitly calls3.10 v3, with developments through3.36 culminating in4.0; reference66 Dockerfiles pin3.10 and3.36.
target.tolerance: Makespan agreement <=1e-6 simulated seconds (local validation rule, not specified by paper); report observed differences and performance ratios without asserting hardware-specific speedup replication.
target.tolerance_basis: Six decimals in native log timestamps. No portable runtime/RSS threshold imposed.
target.scope: Makespan consistency and descriptive endpoint performance/RSS comparison. Complete historical curves and hardware are not matched.

execution.result: 48 native runs: forty performance runs (two Figure 13 endpoints, ten seeds and two versions), six small makespan-validation runs and two paper-size makespan-validation runs. All exited zero; all four makespan checks matched to 0.000001 simulated seconds.

comparison.interpretation: Four makespan consistency checks passed. Local RSS reduction at the tested endpoints is 5.1994x/5.3566x, exceeding the article reported 4.1 minimum. The lower-endpoint wall-time ratio is 1.2995x, below its reported 1.45 minimum. Different host/compiler and partial curves prevent a historical performance-reproduction claim.

failed_attempts: Old 3.10 configure wrote conftestval into current directory; rerunning configure from the build directory resolved it.
Initial 3.36/4.0 builds were exploratory; final recorded comparison is 3.10/3.36.
